english.note: This is the all-purpose possessive modifier placed before a noun, as in 佢本書 “her book”.

exampleSentences.english: Her book is pretty good; I'll lend it to you.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢本書幾好睇，我借畀你睇吓。
